[P2] Return the public behavior change to the design phase

Changing `deserialize` from reading the supplied pointer to selecting a different file changes its public contract. CONTRIBUTING rule 3 requires a design note even for bug fixes that change public APIs. The description explains the chosen implementation but provides neither the required comparison of alternatives nor a reference to an agreed design note. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6), resolve the supported producer identities and compatibility policy, and obtain maintainer agreement. The claimed Lambda replay guarantee also needs cited evidence or an explicit "unverified" label under rule 6.
